2020 Toyota Hiace Van DX GL Package 4WD

AUCTION    TOYOTA    HIACE
  • Bidding Terms
  • Auction Sheet Key

Nichibo endeavors to always provide the best service possible. Please help us to help you;

  • Please check over each auction sheet carefully before placing your bid. Our buyers take for granted that you know all the details such as if vehicle is a 3 door or 5 door or manual or auto.
  • When bidding on European vehicles please check if the vehicle is left or right
  • For your information if a vehicle has a $ next to the km it means the odometer is not genuine or the auction has reason to believe the odometer is not correct.
  • If it has XX on any of the panels this means the panel has been changed, a long line on a panel represents a scratch or the panel has had previous paint work.
  • Please ensure you place your bids before 9am Japan time, this will allow our buying staff in Japan time to inspect any vehicles you place bids on for a final check.
  • Please take care to enter your bid on the correct vehicle.
